invariants.title: Never invent a person: named contacts require a source; facts come only from sources.
A gap is a finding: recorded with a note, listed in the worklist, resolved only with provenance.
Every account earned its place: why_them and source_url are mandatory.
Relationship-graph fields are human-only: refused to agents regardless of role.
Activities record when it happened, not when it was typed.
Nothing is deleted: exclusion and closure are reasoned statuses.
Parking or killing an account requires a reason.
Promotion is a bridge act: won → core customer via the owner's API, at most once.
Provenance survives updates: correctable, never removable.
Interpretation is free; facts are sourced.
Every write is a logged command with an actor; refusals are logged; reads are not.
Every account pursues a campaign; pursuit state is campaign-relative.
No campaign without a goal — the goal is the brief agents read before filling the list.
There is no outbound channel: a draft is written and held; only a person sends it.
A sent draft is immutable and its exact words are copied onto the activity trail; a discarded draft is never revived.
Every draft carries a rationale for its reviewer, and the rationale is never part of what is sent.
What a campaign may claim is written by a person; refused words are checked against every draft and edit alike.
Parking is a fact about what happened and is orthogonal to status; it needs a reason and is reversible.
Account state is derived on read, never stored: an approach already made is never reported as an untouched door.
An event carries the source its date came from; a date not on the source is not a date.
Events are never deleted or reopened: done takes an outcome, cancelled takes a reason.
Attendance is the person's stance and a separate axis from the event's status; it is recorded only on their word.
